lede: Wat Pa O Don Chai accounts for 14 catalogued manuscripts. It clusters in Chiang Rai (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (64%) are written in Thai · อักษรไทย script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (50%) over khoi paper · กระดาษข่อย (50%). Dated witnesses run 1951–1972 CE (13 of 14 carry a date).
